official_sources.title: Guidance for preparing plans for HM Land Registry applications
HM Land Registry plans: title plan (practice guide 40, supplement 5)

verified_facts: deed plans are essential to registration workflows
title plan and register cannot describe land more accurately than supporting pre-registration deeds allow
plans should show precise searched extent by suitable colouring or edging
plans must state their drawing scale
plans must show a north point
plans must show sufficient surrounding detail for OS-map or parent-title-plan identification
PDF printing must not inadvertently reduce the plan to fit paper size
title plan is only one element of a registered title and must be read with the register
title plan guidance was updated 13 July 2026
title plan guidance includes explicit sections on scales, dimensions, surveys and updating plans
application plans should not be marked for identification purposes only where precise extent is required
floor-level extents should be made clear relative to external boundaries or building outline
quality_effect: Fail closed when application or title-plan geometry lacks stated scale, orientation, supporting-detail context or print-scale integrity; do not promote a title plan beyond the precision supported by its source deeds.
